claim: Reports record UK Bible sales in 2025 and a 21-year US high in 2025 (up 12% from 2024), with Gen Z interest cited.
excerpt: Summary: physical Bible sales up 27.7% last year (UK), up 106% since 2019; US sales at a 21-year high in 2025, +12%. Original data sources not identified in the summary.
title: Bible sales reach record high, as Gen Z shows increasing openness
